description:
AFDW/PKH will be hosting a Virtual Industry Day for the A10 Strategic Plans and Policy Support Services requirement to be held via TEAMS at 10:00AM EST on Friday, 27 March 2026. To receive an invite to the Virtual Industry Day, please respond via email to timothy.prymak@us.af.mil with the names and email addresses of attendees. 

Preproposal Slides and Interested Parties List are attached. Please provide any feedback on Discussion Items (slide 16) to Margaret Santos at margaret.santos@us.af.mil and Timothy Prymak at timothy.prymak@us.af.mil.
